identity: Thunderroot Wilds is the trolls' storm jungle at the Throng's far flank; bog witches bottle its thunder and bandits sell what the storm leaves.

quests.title: Ashveil Listens Too
quests.text: Vaska Ashlistener at Ashveil Watch in Blackwind Rise needs help with the people arriving from the fighting. Go and speak to her. She lets a tired carrier finish a sentence, which is rarer than you would think among people waiting for a delivery.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The id stays (its objectives are unchanged); free, it requires nothing.

quests.title: The Next Crew Should Know
quests.text: The carriers have left their reports on a reading cord at the loading ground of Thunderroot Mining Camp. Secure the cord so the next crew can read it before they leave. A loose knot can turn 'the crew is back' into a very long wait.
quests.lesson: A local task; the second armor choice (one enchant, a suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The camp's held load (a town place every mining camp has).

quests.title: One Stolen Storm Fewer
quests.text: The carriers working the {name:stormglades} have enough weather to endure without someone keeping a bottled storm to loose on them. Seal the vessel at the {name:storm_store}, {dir_from_giver:storm_store}, so it cannot be opened against the next crew. Leave it there and bring me word. The rain may be stubborn, but this much we can do something about.
quests.completion: That vessel is sealed against use now. Whoever meant to loose it on our carriers will have to find another way to spoil their journey.
quests.lesson: The zone's solo quest; the weapon choice (prefix and suffix).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. K9 A: the zone's solo quest with its weapon, at a new recipe place in the Stormglades; the new object kind storm_vessel (a placeholder look until the user's art pick).

quests.title: Party: Storm-Bottle
quests.text: {name:storm_bottle_witch} hoards stolen storms in the {name:heartwood} and turns her own magic on anyone who approaches. Gather a group and kill her, {dir_from_giver:storm_bottle_witch}. She has made enough people flinch at thunder that once meant rain for their gardens.
quests.lesson: The optional group quest: free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The optional group quest (round61-plan.md §2 point 8): free, standalone, a trinket choice as its extra.

quests.title: The People Under the Banner
quests.text: Yarra Standardmender at Tornstandard Hold on Bannerbreak Mesa needs help with the fighting beyond our posts. Go and speak to her about it. She keeps the names of the fallen in her banners and a sharp eye on what the living still need.
quests.lesson: A travel quest, free (a level only).
quests.notes: Round 61 BANDQUESTS. The departure at 40 (round61-plan.md §2 point 7); free, it requires nothing.
